title: C40 Spech
prompt: Close-up of one sly hooded spy in a dark leather hood and a black cloth mask over the lower face, only his narrow eyes visible and glowing bright orange, he holds a single stolen playing card with a plain dark back up between two gloved fingers, wisps of bright orange chaos smoke curl around the card and his hood, small crackling orange sparks. Background: cold dark teal night alley with blurred rooftops, strong contrast of glowing orange chaos against cold dark teal. No text, no symbols on the card.

title: C44 Dan
prompt: Medium shot of a heavy iron-bound treasure chest standing open on a rocky hill, a swirling vortex of bright orange chaos energy pours out of it and rips glowing stone blocks from a crumbling castle tower in the background, the blocks fly through the air into the chest, crackling orange lightning, orange sparks and dust. No people. Background: hazy golden yellow and amber sky. Palette: gold, amber, bright orange, dark iron, no teal. No text.

title: C08 Zazrak
prompt: Low-angle wide shot of a ruined castle keep miraculously rebuilding itself: hundreds of stone blocks float up from the rubble on swirling streams of bright orange chaos energy and click into place, the tower rising higher and stronger, crackling orange lightning, glowing orange seams between the stones, orange sparks. No people. Background: dramatic deep red and orange sunrise sky with clouds. Palette: crimson, scarlet, bright orange, yellow light, dark stone, no teal. No text.

title: C13 Sabotaz
prompt: Macro close-up of a huge glowing blue magic crystal deep in a mine, chained with iron to the rock, a jagged spike of bright orange chaos energy has been driven into its heart, glowing orange cracks spread through the blue crystal and it starts to shatter into flying shards, crackling orange lightning, orange sparks, the blue glow dying. No people, no hands. Background: cold dark teal cave, strong contrast of glowing orange chaos against cold dark teal. No text.

title: C14 Kamenolom
prompt: Wide shot of a large stone quarry with terraced grey rock walls, a wooden crane and stacked stone blocks, a massive glowing bright orange chaos crack splits the quarry wall and the cliff collapses, boulders and the crane fall, clouds of dust lit orange from inside, crackling orange lightning from the crack. No people. Background: dusty yellow-orange sky. Palette: ochre, amber, bright orange, grey stone, no teal. No text.
